actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.download_message_attachment.desc: Download the content of a message attachment, such as an MMS photo or a voicemail recording, and return it as a file.
actions.download_message_attachment.prop: Which attachment to download. Leave blank to take the first one that is not the message text, which is the usual case for an MMS carrying a single photo.
Overrides the name RingCentral reports. Worth setting when the name matters downstream, e.g. naming a POD after the load number.
The message the attachment belongs to.
actions.get_call_log.description: Retrieve call log records for the authenticated user's extension.
actions.get_call_log.props.dateFrom.desc: The start of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).
actions.get_call_log.props.dateTo.descri: The end of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z).
actions.get_call_log.props.perPage.descr: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000).
actions.get_extension_info.description: Get profile information for the authenticated user's extension.
actions.get_message.description: Retrieve a single SMS, MMS or voicemail message, including the list of attachments it carries.
actions.get_message.props.messageId.desc: The message to read. The New Inbound SMS or MMS trigger emits this as `id`.
actions.make_call.description: Start a two-legged RingOut call: RingCentral calls the "from" number first, then connects it to the "to" number.
actions.make_call.props.callerId.descrip: Optional number shown to the callee, in E.164 format. Must be one of your RingCentral numbers.
actions.make_call.props.from.description: The number RingCentral calls first, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550100). Usually one of your RingCentral numbers.
actions.make_call.props.playPrompt.descr: Play a "please hold" prompt to the "from" party before connecting the call.
actions.make_call.props.to.description: The number to connect the call to, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550123).
actions.send_sms.description: Send an SMS text message from one of your RingCentral numbers.
actions.send_sms.props.from.description: The SMS-enabled RingCentral number to send from.
actions.send_sms.props.text.description: The text content of the SMS message.
actions.send_sms.props.to.description: Recipient phone number(s) in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550123).
actions.send_team_message.description: Post a message to a RingCentral Team Messaging chat, group, or team.
actions.send_team_message.props.chatId.d: The direct message, group or team to post to.
actions.send_team_message.props.text.des: The text content of the post. Supports Markdown.
auth.description: In the [RingCentral Developer Console](https://developers.ringcentral.com/), create a REST API app using **OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Flow)** for a server/web app. Add the redirect URI shown here to the app, then enable the app scopes you need (for example: SMS, RingOut, Read Messages, Read Call Log, Read Accounts, TeamMessaging, Webhook Subscriptions). Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret below, and pick the Environment that matches your app.
auth.props.environment.description: The RingCentral server your app is registered on.
description: Cloud business communications: send SMS, place calls, manage messages, and post to Team Messaging.
triggers.new_inbound_sms.description: Triggers when a new inbound text message is received, with or without media attached.
triggers.new_team_message.description: Triggers when a new post is added in RingCentral Team Messaging.
triggers.new_voicemail.description: Triggers when a new voicemail message is received.
